summary: Uncommitted order-total computation; the service test asserts the mock's canned return value and computeTotals is checked with toBeTruthy.

defects.description: `places an order with a coupon` asserts `order.totalCents` from the mocked repo.save, which returns the canned `saved` object, so it checks the fixture rather than the computation; any totals bug passes. It should assert what save was called with (toHaveBeenCalledWith with subtotal 2000, discount 200, total 1800).
`computes totals` uses toBeTruthy() on an object, which is always truthy, so the test cannot fail; every arithmetic mutant in computeTotals (reduce, `*`, `-`, rounding) survives.
The coupon clamp to 0..50% (Math.min/Math.max, MAX_COUPON_PERCENT) and rounding to whole cents are never tested; coupons above 50, negative coupons, and an odd subtotal (rounding) are needed.
